$comment: Introduction formulas: the fixed wording for introducing the event, a day, a session, a speaker, a panel, a demo, a video, a break and a close. One formula per moment, so every announcement, film and run of show introduces things the same way. Slots are {name}; [square brackets] mark an optional part that is dropped when its slot is empty. Fill slots only with supplied facts (the agenda, the person's own approved title). guides/NARRATION.md (Introductions) explains each rule. scripts/voice/say.py fills and voices them; scripts/lint/lint.py checks any text tagged "intro": "<id>" against its formula.

slots.event: Event name as spoken: 'Agency twenty twenty six' (brand/voice/lexicon.json).
slots.greeting: 'Good morning' before noon, 'Good afternoon' after, 'Good evening' after 5 p.m.
slots.name: The person's name exactly as they gave it, with the honorific they use ('the Honourable Jordan Sample'). Ask how it is said; add it to the lexicon.
slots.role: The person's own job title, as approved by the person ('Deputy Minister of Technology and Innovation'). No adjectives.
slots.org: Organization, full name, no acronym ('the Alberta Energy Regulator').
slots.title: Session, demo or video title exactly as in the agenda.
slots.place: Room or venue as in the agenda ('Hall D', 'the Edmonton Convention Centre').
slots.time: Clock time as spoken: 'ten thirty', 'one o'clock' (no 'a.m.' unless ambiguous).
slots.day_title: The day's title from tokens.json event.days[].title.
slots.day_sub: The day's subtitle from tokens.json event.days[].sub, starting lower case: 'a showcase for government'.
slots.what: The product's or organization's purpose in plain words, starting lower case: 'an AI agent that answers general questions by phone'. Supplied by its owner.
slots.team: Team or branch that built it, full name.
slots.subject: The video's subject in plain words, starting lower case.
slots.where: A place with its preposition, as said: 'in Edmonton' for a city, 'at Platform Calgary' for a venue. Only the first part of an agenda place before ' · ' is spoken.

intros.speaker: announcer
intros.when: First words of each day, after the opening sequence (MG-01).
intros.spoken: Good morning, and welcome to Agency twenty twenty six.

intros.speaker: announcer
intros.when: After event-open, or after the day bumper (MG-02).
intros.spoken: Day one of Agency twenty twenty six is The Art of the Possible, a showcase for government.

intros.speaker: announcer
intros.when: Safety, exits, phones, washrooms, accessibility services.
intros.rule: Read the venue's and the event owner's text word for word. Do not write or improve it.

intros.speaker: host
intros.when: As the event owner directs.
intros.rule: Read the event owner's text word for word, by the person the owner names. Never generated, never shortened, never voiced by text to speech unless the owner says so.

intros.speaker: announcer
intros.when: As a speaker walks to the lectern; plays over a walk-up sting (brand/audio/cues.json walkup-*).
intros.spoken: Please welcome Jordan Sample, Director of Sample Services, the Ministry of Example Affairs.

intros.speaker: host
intros.when: A host introduces the next speaker from the stage.
intros.spoken: To present Sample Session Title, please welcome Jordan Sample, Director of Sample Services, the Ministry of Example Affairs.

intros.speaker: announcer
intros.when: Optional second sentence after a walk-up or handoff, only with a fact the speaker approved.
intros.rule: One sentence, one fact the speaker supplied or approved (a role held, a program led). Repeat the name; no pronoun. No praise words.

example.name: Jordan Sample
example.fact: leads the Sample Services modernization program

intros.spoken: Jordan Sample leads the Sample Services modernization program.

intros.speaker: announcer
intros.when: Before a panel takes the stage.
intros.spoken: Please welcome the panel for Sample Panel Title.

intros.speaker: announcer
intros.when: One line per panellist, in the agenda's order, moderator last.
intros.spoken: Alex Example, Chief Data Officer, the Sample Agency.

intros.speaker: announcer
intros.when: The last panel line.
intros.spoken: Casey Placeholder, Executive Director, the Example Office, moderates the panel.

intros.speaker: announcer
intros.when: A session title card goes up.
intros.spoken: Sample Session Title begins now, in Hall D.

intros.speaker: announcer
intros.when: Lobby or countdown call before a session.
intros.spoken: Sample Session Title begins in five minutes, in Hall D.

intros.speaker: announcer
intros.when: Before a showcase demo.
intros.rule: Defines the product in the same sentence that names it (appositive rule). 'what' comes from the demo's owner.

example.title: Sample Demo
example.what: a tool that drafts replies to ministerial letters for staff to review

intros.spoken: Sample Demo is a tool that drafts replies to ministerial letters for staff to review, built by the Example Branch.

intros.speaker: announcer
intros.when: After demo-intro.
intros.spoken: Jordan Sample, Product Lead, presents the demo.

intros.speaker: announcer
intros.when: Before a video plays in the room.

example.title: Sample Video Title
example.subject: how one team replaced a paper form

intros.spoken: Sample Video Title is a video about how one team replaced a paper form.

intros.speaker: announcer
intros.when: Start of a break.
intros.spoken: The program resumes at ten thirty in Hall D.

intros.speaker: announcer
intros.when: Start of lunch.
intros.template: Lunch is served in {place}. The program resumes at {time}.
intros.spoken: Lunch is served in the north foyer. The program resumes at one o'clock.

intros.speaker: announcer
intros.when: Return-from-break countdown, a few minutes before the restart.
intros.template: The program resumes in {minutes} minutes. Please take your seats.
intros.spoken: The program resumes in five minutes. Please take your seats.

intros.speaker: announcer
intros.when: After the last session of a day. Thanks come from the owner.
intros.template: Day {day_number} of {event} is complete. Day {next_day_number} begins at {time}[ {where}].
intros.spoken: Day one of Agency twenty twenty six is complete. Day two begins at nine o'clock in Edmonton.

intros.speaker: host
intros.when: The end of the event.
intros.rule: Thanks, credit and closing words are the event owner's. Leave a placeholder and ask.

intros.speaker: narrator
intros.when: Any film, the first time an organization is named.
intros.rule: An organization enters with what it does: 'The Alberta Energy Regulator, which licenses oil and gas wells, checks those taxes.'

intros.speaker: narrator
intros.when: A film names a person or quotes one.
intros.rule: Full name and approved title on first mention, then the full name again (no pronoun). Quote only words the person approved, and say who said them before the quote.

intros.speaker: screen
intros.when: On screen while a person speaks (show lower third, MG-03, MVAI people).
intros.rule: Two lines. Name as given; role and organization on line two separated by ' · '. No full stops, no 'Mr.' or 'Dr.' unless the person uses it.

fixed_lines.$comment: Lines that open or close a section of a system or prototype explainer (the client-approved Prototype Lab profile, adapted for Agency). They are allowed exactly as written, although 'Here's how' is wayfinding elsewhere.
fixed_lines.roles-open: Let's have a look at this system, which will support several roles.
fixed_lines.integrations-open: In production, several integrations are needed, including
fixed_lines.integrations-close: In the test environment, these integrations are all simulated.
fixed_lines.try-open: You can try this system now
